claims.claim: The Saviour repository is public, MIT licensed, with commit 89f3902 on main.
claims.method: GitHub API: MIT, created 2026-09-06, commit 89f39028 dated 2026-11-18 ('feat(audit): enhance audit status handling and update report schema').
npm registry: latest version 0.1.0, MIT, published 2026-11-18. Package behavior was not run.

claims.claim: www.saviours.xyz/audit and a pilots page are live.
claims.method: Both pages return HTTP 200 with the described content (Safe address form; a team proof, Term Safe at block 26435999). No audit was run and the digest was not recomputed.

claims.claim: No outside team has run a pilot yet.
claims.method: The pilots page lists only the team proof run on 17 Nov 2026 and states that it does not count. This is the applicant's own page. A negative statement cannot be confirmed from the applicant's own page, so it is not marked Verified.

claims.claim: A Safe lost about $6.45 million on 16 Nov 2026 through a Zodiac Roles modifier.
claims.method: Cointelegraph (Nov 16, 2026) reports about $6.45 million and Zodiac's co-founder saying a likely compromised key was involved. CoinMarketCap Academy reports Safe said no owner signed and cites 4.39 million USDC and 1.72 million syrupUSDC.

claims.claim: Kesavi Web Solutions has committed $2,500, 25% of the goal.
claims.method: The company website loads but does not mention Saviour or any commitment.
